name: SGCNeRF
definition: A few-shot neural rendering architecture for novel view synthesis that uses a feature-matching-based sparse geometry regularization module, enhanced by spatially consistent geometry filtering and frequency-guided geometric regularization to address overfitting and preserve high-frequency details.
summary: SGCNeRF is a few-shot neural rendering architecture that preserves high-frequency details by integrating sparse geometric consistency guidance with frequency-guided regularization.
